title: fix(template): transformData checks too strict
body:
The Template component shouldn't throw an error if you define
the transformData for a single templateKey.

Fix #347

comments.body:
> I have trouble understanding the fix + the test given the bug explanation:

Using `transformData` with an object should not impact the non-specified template keys. Here it was used with `{hit: fn}` and the `empty` function wasn't found while generating the `empty` templateKey:  therefore we threw an exception. I introduced the bug in https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/213
